result_text:
I trimmed the promotion code in `PromotionService.createPromotion` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/service/PromotionService.java`). The change is one line, `code = code.trim();`, placed right after the blank check.

The trimmed code now goes into the duplicate check and into storage. So `"  SPRING10 "` is saved and shown as `SPRING10`, and it is found by that code. Creating `SPRING10` again, with or without spaces, is rejected as a duplicate.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='*Promotion*'`, which produced no output and no failures. I didn't add a test for the spaces case.

I only changed creation. Lookups with spaces still don't match, for example `limitToRegion("  SPRING10 ", …)`. Say so if you want those trimmed too.
